epic.title: Sprint 0 — Delivery pipeline
epic.description: Monorepo, Azure/Neon/GitHub setup, the four required checks (build & unit, integration, QA deploy, UI tests), prod deploy and branch rules, as decided in planning/CI-CD.md.

features.title: Monorepo layout and developer tooling
tasks: Monorepo layout: api/, jobs/, web/, tests/, design/, planning/
Formatting and lint: dotnet format, ESLint, Prettier, .editorconfig
Local PostgreSQL with Docker Compose and a seeded dev database
Developer README: run API, web, jobs and all tests locally

features.title: Azure, Neon and GitHub environments
tasks: Step-by-step setup guide for the owner (Azure, Neon, GitHub)
Owner creates resource group, Static Web App, Container Apps environment (api-prod, api-qa, jobs), container registry
owner
Owner creates the Neon project with main and qa branches
owner
GitHub environments prod and qa with their secrets
OIDC federated sign-in GitHub → Azure, verified from a workflow
features.no_tests: Verified by the deploy smoke checks

features.title: Deployable API and web skeletons
tasks: ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) minimal API with /health, OpenAPI and Dockerfile
React + TypeScript Vite app shell calling /health
Smoke test that runs after every deploy

features.title: Build & unit-test pipeline (check: build-and-unit)
tasks: Workflow: restore, build and unit tests for API, jobs and web
Lint, format and type check inside the check
Code coverage collected, posted as a PR summary, with a minimum that fails the check

features.title: Integration-test pipeline (check: integration)
tasks: Testcontainers PostgreSQL fixture; migrations applied per run
Workflow job with test-results report on the PR

features.title: Shared QA deploy pipeline (check: deploy-qa)
tasks: Build and push the API image; deploy to api-qa
Apply migrations to the Neon qa branch
Deploy the web app to the Static Web Apps 'qa' environment
Queue: one PR at a time on QA (deploy + UI tests in one run)
PR comment 'QA now shows PR #n' with the QA links
'Deploy this PR to QA again' re-run

features.title: UI-test pipeline (check: ui-tests)
tasks: Playwright projects: phone 393×852 and desktop 1440, light and dark
Run against QA after deploy; keep traces, screenshots and video on failure
First smoke journey: open the app, switch tabs, switch theme

features.title: Prod deploy on merge to main
tasks: On merge: build, migrate the prod database, deploy API then web
Smoke tests against prod after deploy; failure alerts the owner
Reset the Neon qa branch to a fresh copy of prod after each prod deploy
Rollback guide: redeploy the previous image and web build
features.no_tests: Verified by the prod smoke tests

features.title: Branch rules and PR hygiene
tasks: Ruleset on main: PRs only; required checks build-and-unit, integration, deploy-qa, ui-tests; up to date; conversations resolved
PR template with a testing checklist
Proof: a deliberately failing test blocks the merge
Dependabot for NuGet, npm and GitHub Actions; CodeQL scanning

features.title: Golden files from the Python keeper build
tasks: Freeze Python outputs: PvP boxes and strings, raid rankings, Mega lists, search-simulator results
Golden-file test harness for the C# port: exact comparison with a readable diff
Keep the Python pipeline runnable until the C# port matches
